<div class="intro-text">
<span class="curated-description-message"></span>
<div class="rich-editor rich-text-editor curated-description" data-placeholder="Write a page description...">
<p>Few of the challenges humanity faces are as urgent and complex as food security. To meet the needs of a rapidly growing world population, an unparalleled, worldwide effort is required. Members of the AgriProFocus Network are dedicated to meeting this challenge in collaboration. By working together, learning from each other and unitedly pushing for change.</p><p>AgriProFocus brings together farmers, agribusinesses, civil society, knowledge institutes and governments. United in diversity, our members show that agribusiness and development are not mutually exclusive. Together, we find new, sustainable ways of creating impact with business. Exchanging perspectives and expecting the unexpected. Cultivating collaboration through linking, learning and leadership.</p><h4><b>LINKING</b> - <i>Build successful partnerships</i></h4><p>AgriProFocus helps you find the right people to solve problems and do business with. Whether you are looking for change makers in the agri-food sector or partners to solve specific challenges with. Our network connects (un)usual suspects, facilitates innovative ways of working together and stimulates long term collaboration.</p><h4><b>LEARNING</b> - <i>Expand your expertise</i></h4><p>AgriProFocus facilitates exciting learning environments aimed at innovating your business. Our members share best practices, experiences and failures in order to learn from and with each other. Reflection and sense-making around specific issues are key in our learning processes.</p><h4><b>LEADERSHIP</b> - <i>Find your leverage</i></h4><p>AgriProFocus is the space for you to set and influence the agenda in collaboration with other relevant stakeholders. Our network aims to change both the ways of working and the rules of the game in the agri-food sector. By collectively improving the business environment for agripreneurs, we make sure impact is made at scale.</p><div class="medium-insert-images ui-sortable" contenteditable="false" id="mediumInsert-46" style="display: none;"><div class="mediumInsert-buttons" style="display: none;"><a class="mediumInsert-buttonsShow" title="Open menu"><span class="glyphicon glyphicon-plus"><span></span></span></a><div class="overlayDivHolder"></div><div class="place" style="max-width:300px;"></div><ul class="mediumInsert-buttonsOptions medium-editor-toolbar medium-editor-toolbar-active" style="display: none;"><li><button class="medium-editor-action medium-editor-action-image mediumInsert-action" data-action="add" data-addon="images" title="Add an image"><i class="fa fa-picture-o"></i></button></li><li><button class="medium-editor-action medium-editor-action-pdf mediumInsert-action" data-action="add" data-addon="embeds" title="Add a video"><i class="fa fa-code"></i></button></li><li><button class="medium-editor-action medium-editor-action-image mediumInsert-action" data-action="add" data-addon="dividers" title="Add a new part"> <i class="fa fa-arrows-h"></i> </button></li></ul></div><div class="mediumInsert-placeholder"></div></div><p style="display: block;"><b>Dutch Members 2019:</b> </p><div class="medium-insert-images"><i></i><figure contenteditable="false">

<p></p><h1><b>Are you part of the Rice and Maize value chain in Eastern Province?</b></h1><p>ICCO Cooperation - STARS Program in collaboration with AgriProFocus Rwanda is pleased to invite you in a Rice and Maize Value chain Business to Business (B2B) event that will take <b>on Thursday, November 14th , 2018 at ELEGANCIA Hotel Kayonza district, Eastern Province of Rwanda from 8:00 am 4:00 pm.</b></p><p>The purpose of this Business to Business event is to link Rice and Maize value chain actors and supporters to connect, collaborate, and create synergy in business. It is also a great opportunity for networking and conversation that lead to businesses opportunities. We are looking forward to meeting you in this B2B event. </p><p>For any information kindly call Mr. Thacien MUNYAMAHAME on 0788235357 or send an email at <a class="linkified" href="mailto:t.munyamahame@icco.nl">t.munyamahame@icco.nl</a></p><h1>If you are interested, please register <b><a href="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScIz9yS7UXAC7yEF5sQ832_guRnDdMSHcfdK8kHERlhDUHI7A/viewform?usp=sf_link" target="_blank">HERE</a></b></h1><p><br/></p><p></p>

<p></p><h1>Netherlands Food Partnership launched during World Food Day</h1><h4>The celebration of World Food Day 2019 was the perfect occasion to launch the Netherlands Food Partnership. Yet, despite all efforts and successes in improving our food systems, we are not on track to achieve food security and improved nutrition by 2030. <p></p><h1><b>African delegates call governments to adopt poultry to tame poverty and stunting plight</b></h1><p><b>Poultry farmers from across Africa have called governments to promote poultry industry if the leaders want to significantly improve the livelihood of Africans, especially in terms of nutrition.</b></p><p>They have made their request at the just-concluded Poultry Learning Programme organized by AgriProFocus Rwanda in collaboration with Resiliencia Rwanda and PUM for the emerging farmers from Burundi, Cameroon, Ethiopia, Netherlands, Tanzania, Uganda, Zambia and Rwanda. The Poultry learning programme place ahead of the poultry Africa 2019 that lasted two days in Kigali, October 2nd – 3rd, 2019.</p><p><b>Demeke Wondmagen</b> is the board secretary of Ethiopian Poultry Producers and Processors association. He says that poultry is the only industry that offers quick return on investment, requires less land and low labor but produces steady income and above all a highly protein source.</p><p><b><i>“Poultry is a source of a highly rich and aff</i></b></p><p></p>...

<div class="jqueryHashtags"><div class="highlighter"></div><div class="typehead"><div class="event-detail edit-event-description theSelector" style="word-wrap: break-word;">
<p></p><h1>You are invited to celebrate “World Food Day in Ethiopia: Circular Economy &amp; Food Security” - Wednesday 16 October 2019  </h1><h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><a href="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeaTIDBO2GzT5Zto3OFBjguTeGE4nByJQcBAn4VxOoHg8XGaw/viewform" target="_blank">Please Confirm your attendance by registering here</a></span></h4><p>World Food Day in Ethiopia will be organized by the
AgriProFocus Ethiopia network in collaboration with Wageningen University and
with support from The Embassy of The Kingdom of The Netherlands. During this
event, we aim to connect the topics Circular Economy and Food Security and
explore the opportunities of circular business models for the agri-food sector
in Ethiopia <b><i><span style="text-decoration: underline;">(find attached below the tentative program of the day).</span></i></b><br/></p><p></p><h4>The World Food Day event will close with the celebration of the 10-year anniversary of the AgriProFocus network in Ethiopia.</h4><p><span>The main goal of the World Food Day in Ethiopia is to raise awareness for SDG 2 and to provide a place where knowledge, expertise, and solutions are shared. We aim to bring together professionals from government, business, science, and civil society and to inspire them t</span></p><p></p>...
<a href="//agriprofocus.com/post/5d9600fd26b72a3685660894"><b>Read more</b></a>
</div></div></div>

<p></p><h1>             Partnership lunch</h1><p>Le Mardi 01 Octobre 2019 s’est tenu au restaurant le pilier de Niamey un déjeuner de partenariat entre le réseau AgriProFocus et les membres d’une mission du Ministère des Affaires Étrangères du Pays. Cette mission fait suite à une étude sur l’intervention du Pays Bas dans la sous-région ouest africaine dans trois pays à savoir : le Burkina Faso, le Mali au Niger dans le cadre de la promotion de l’entrepreneuriat des jeunes dans le secteur agricole. Pour le Niger trois filières sont tenues : le Moringa, le Lait et le Maraîchage. </p><p>L’objectif de ce déjeuner est de discuter sur comment s’appuyer sur ce que le réseau AgriProFocus Niger fait déjà dans le cadre de la promotion de l’entrepreneuriat des jeunes et femmes, pour élargir au plus grand nombre des jeunes dans les régions de Tahoua, Maradi et Niamey.</p><p>A ce titre AgriProFocus Niger a partagé ses expériences avec les membres de la mission acco</p><p></p>...

<p></p><h1>DAY 1- Poultry Learning Programme 2019</h1><p><b>Chicken farmers are with hopes the 2nd edition of Poultry Africa Summit will instil in them a wake-up will power to make that chicken price becomes proportionate to the cost of the product.</b></p><p>Emerging farmers who attended our organized “Poultry Learning event 2019” September 30, 2019 said they’re facing losses due to unceasing hike of birds feed prices, yet the price of their product isn’t follow suit.</p><p>“Poultry learning Event” is a program that we’re holding two days ahead of the big Poultry Africa 2019. On our first day, the participants get to visit two modern farms in Mayange, Bugesera district in east Rwanda.</p><p>PEAL and ABUSOL are the modern farms we visited and the participants got to explore the poultry operations, exchange with the staffs and networking. A group of 29 people and 24 people visited ABUSOL and PEAL ltd poultry farms, respectively. PEAL, Poultry East Africa Ltd is a poultry farming social enterprise based in Bugesera, on </p><p></p>...

<p></p><h1>Vacancy: Management &amp; Office Assistant - AgriProFocus Utrecht</h1><p><i>32-36 hrs - based in Utrecht</i></p><h4>You are always ‘the organiser’ and people praise you for your hospitality, enthusiasm and creativity. <p></p><h1>Update Projet JEEN/YEEN.</h1><p>AgriProFocus-Niger est membre à part entière du consortium composé de UNCDF, OXFAM, DGDCT et la SNV (qui assure le lead) chargé de conduire le projet dénommé « Les jeunes entreprennent et s’ (auto)emploient au Niger communément appelé JEEN. Pour une durée de trois ans (2019-2021), ce projet financé par l’Union Européenne, a pour objectif global de contribuer à la création d’emplois innovants et à la stabilité sociale au profit de 3750 jeunes âgés de 18 à 40 ans dont 40% des femmes et 15% de migrants de retour notamment à travers la promotion de la création d'emploi, le soutien du développement économique local durable et résilient aux changements climatiques et la mise en place d’un écosystème qui favorise le développement des entreprises.</p><p>Le projet intervient dans vingt-quatre (24) communes dont dix-sept ( 17) communes de la région de Tahoua et sept (7) communes de la région de Zinder. Dans le cadre de ce projet et confor</p><p></p>...

<p style="padding-right:1%">
<small class="comment" style="word-wrap: break-word;">
<a class="author-name" href="//agriprofocus.com/profile/19094">Moutari Malam Adamou</a>
Très bon projet en ce moment où les jeunes ont beaucoup besoins d'appui. Je vous félicite beaucoup l'équipe du Niger toujours dynamique. J'espère de tout coeur que vous alliez très loin dans cet accompagnement de la jeunesse dans l'auto emploi, comme vous je crois sincèrement à ça. Il faut de plus en plus de financement de ce genre et un accompagnement pas seulement des structures comme la votre avec vos projets mais un accompagnement à tous les niveaux. Je suis content de voir que les mairies et les gouvernorats sont dans la démarche, il faut penser aussi à inviter les services d’impôts. Ça aidera à accompagner. Je m'explique : si le promoteur mettais son projet en oeuvre après acquisition de votre financement, ça lui prendra du temps pour se confirmer, bien asseoir son affaire, avoir la clientèle, etc. Si dès au départ il faisait ses installations sur la route par exemple avec l'accord de la mairie normalement en conformité avec les plans d'urbanisation et que sais je encore, ces installations ne risqueront pas de souffrir des déguerpissements. Pour la part des impôts, peut être dans un souci d'accompagnement des efforts du projet et des bailleurs qui ont financé parce que c'est la politique du pays est d'accord avec, ils (les impôts) doivent trouver un allègement pour les premières années du démarrage du projet de ces jeunes promoteurs voire même une exemption fiscale pendant quelques années. IL FAUT QUE CHACUN CONNAISSE LA POLITIQUE DE L'ETAT ET QUE CHACUN ACCOMPAGNE DANS SA SPHÈRE DE COMPÉTENCE AFIN QUE DES TELS FINANCEMENTS QUE VOUS APPORTEZ, QUE NOUS APPORTONS PUISSE PERMETTRE DE BOUSTER ENTREPRENEURIAT ET L’AUTO EMPLOI DES JEUNES.      
</small>
</p>
<p>
<small> 1 week 6 days ago </small>
</p>

<p></p><h1>ACCESS TO FINANCE DIALOGUE</h1><p>AgriProFocus in collaboration with the Kenya Commercial Bank (KCB) under the MobiGrow program held the first access to finance dialogue on 1st August 2019 at Silver Springs Hotel Nairobi. The dialogue themed, “Integrating Financial Inclusion and Sustainability to Accelerate Uptake of Digital Financial Solutions by Small Holder Farmers” brought together different development partners who are implementing projects with target beneficiaries’ small holder farmers.</p><p>KCB MobiGrow program is a 5 year partnership program between the MasterCard Foundation and KCB Group Limited that targets agricultural value chain actors to offer mobile-based financial inclusion and information to smallholder farmers and pastoralists in Kenya and Rwanda.The program aims to deliver a highly innovative and scalable digital financial ecosystem solution for rural smallholders and pastoralists; Improve productivity amongst rural agro-entrepreneurs through facilitating quality extension, </p><p></p>...

<p></p><h1>New Member: <br/>University of Tilburg - Zero Hunger Lab</h1><p>We are happy to announce that University of Tilburg - Zero Hunger Lab is now a member of the AgriProFocus Network!! </p><h4>Data Science for Zero Hunger Lab</h4><p>Tilburg University decided to invest in their Data Science for Social Good program and build together with partners from Government, Academia, Business and Civil Society in the Netherlands and Africa the Zero Hunger Lab. The Zero Hunger Lab (ZHL) provides the Research and Development knowledge and capacity to assess, analyse, co create and deliver data science solutions that will enable not only the UN WFP but also all other key players and especially local farmers, communities, logistics service providers and government to fight hunger.</p><p><a data-entity-substitution="media" data-entity-type="media" data-entity-uuid="f8eb05f5-2884-45e5-9027-85d5afa2ebc7" download="" href="https://www.tilburguniversity.edu/sites/tiu/files/download/2018.11.01%20%20ZHL_Introduction_MoFa_1.pdf" title="Presentation Data Science for Zero Hunger Lab">Read more in their presentation</a>  <br/></p><p></p>

<p></p><h1>LA JCI Bamako-Espoir honore AgriProFocus</h1><h4>Pour ses activités de facilitation du Projet de promotion de l’entrepreneuriat féminin dénommé « Femmes Leaders -Femmes Entrepreneures » ; la Jeune Chambre Internationale Bamako Espoir décerne une attestation de reconnaissance à votre réseau AgriProFocus Mali .</h4><p>Sachez cher partenaire JCI que le fruit le plus agréable et le plus utile au monde est la reconnaissance et ladite reconnaissance est la mémoire du cœur selon Hans Christian Andersen</p><blockquote><div>Le Réseau AgriProFocus se réjouit de cette reconnaissance qu’elle dédie aux partenaires de son Global Youth Programme et surtout à la DCI Monaco qui a rendu possible le Projet Entrepreneuriat Agrcole Jeune qui nous a permis de vous accompagner pour faire de l’agrobusiness le moteur du developpement par la promotion d’une culture de collaboration pour un impact collectif de changement .</div></blockquote><p>Le mardi 06 Août a été un rendez-vous important pour les membres de la Jeune Chambre Internationale B</p><p></p>...

<a class="author-name" href="//agriprofocus.com/profile/17297">ADA MAHAMANE Habou</a>
Une très bonne initiative Monsieur Georges!Mes vives félicitations et encouragements aux jeunes et femmes bénéficiaires du projet qui rentre dans une dynamique de l'auto-emploi au profit de la jeunesse africaine.En effet, la caravane des agripreneurs sur l'axe Bamako-Ouaga-Cotonou permettra aux jeunes de ces trois pays de partager leurs expériences entrepreneuriales. Ceci permettra une intégration des pratiques entrepreneuriales et commerciales. Certainement au delà, de ces pays toute l'Afrique, d'où le sens de la Zone de Libre Echanges Continentale Africaine (ZLECAF) dont la ratification par les Etats membres de l'Union Africaine a eu lieu le 07/08 juillet 2019 lors du rendez-vous historique de Niamey en République du Niger.
</small>

<p></p><h1><a class="user-hashtag" href="//agriprofocus.com/topic/network?topic=NETWORK">#NETWORK</a> <a class="user-hashtag" href="//agriprofocus.com/topic/highlight?topic=highlight">#highlight</a>! </h1><h1>An exclusive interview with Moussabihatou Saloufou about promoting Agribusiness in Benin!</h1><p><i>*This interview is translated in English, read here the <a href="https://agriprofocus.com/post/5d3eca6726b72a7e9fcbb871" target="_blank">original post in French</a></i></p><h4>The development of Africa largely depends on the agricultural sector. Because of this many organisations are working hard to make this sector the backbone of the economy. Located in African countries, including Benin, the AgriProFocus network has been active for several years to establish a bridge between financial services and producers. The Agrifinance fair, which was organised for the 6th time a few weeks ago, is one of the activities facilitated by the APF network to achieve the objective of making agribusiness work for development.</h4><p><br/></p><p>In an exclusive interview <b>Moussabihatou Saloufou</b>, Benin’s Marketing and Communication Officer, informs us about this platform and its countless efforts to positively impact the African economy by financing the agricultural sector.</p><h4>Could you introduce yourself and the</h4><p></p>...

<p></p><h1>Les femmes et les jeunes: Des  délaissés des microfinances</h1><h4>Le secteur de la microfinance au service des catégories les moins servies, c’est l’un des grands thèmes développés pendant la semaine de la microfinance au Burundi. Cet évenement a été lancé officiellement par le ministre des finances Mr Domitien Ndihokubwayo le mercredi 07 Août 2019 pour se clôturer vendredi le 09 du même mois.</h4><p>Selon les panelistes, les microfinances s’intéressent moins aux femmes et aux jeunes à cause de leur accès limité aux ressources. Cependant, la réalité est que les femmes sont plus solvables que les hommes. Quant aux jeunes, Alexis Hatungimana, paneliste d’ICCO Coopération regrette qu’il y a une faible demande des services disponibles aux microfinances. Il évoque plusieurs facteurs qui y sont liés. Il s’agit entre autres de faibles accès à l’information des services financiers existants, le manque de garanti et faible accès aux ressources. </p><p>Cependant, les jeune</p><p></p>...

<p></p><h1><b>Youth Agribusiness Forum (YAFO-Niger 2019) </b><br/></h1><p>Dans le cadre du renforcement et de la consolidation des actions déjà menés, le reseau <b>AgriProFocus-Niger</b>, en marge de la journée mondiale de la jeunesse, organise la première édition de Youth Agribusiness Forum (<b>YAFO-Niger 2019</b>) aujourd’hui 8 et demain 9 aout 2019 dans la Maison de la Presse dans l’enceinte du ministère de la Jeunesse et des Sports sous le thème « Opportunités entrepreneuriales pour les jeunes au Niger. Ce forum s’inscrit dans la dynamique de promotion et d’éveil entrepreneurial pour les jeunes au Niger. L’objectif général de cet évènement est la création d’un cadre d’échanges et de partage d’expériences autour des opportunités entrepreneuriales au Niger. Durant ce forum les jeunes sont informés sur les possibilités et opportunités entrepreneuriales à travers l’animation de panels de discussions et le partage d’expériences par les entrepreneurs déjà inscrits dans une dynamique entrepren</p><p></p>...

<div class="jqueryHashtags"><div class="highlighter"></div><div class="typehead"><div class="col-lg-12 col-md-12 edit-post-description theSelector" id="editor-5d49771626b72a7e9fcbb948" style="word-wrap: break-word;">
<p></p><h1>Productive dairy dialogue &amp; business drinks</h1><p>AgriProFocus Uganda in collaboration with the Netherlands East African Dairy Partnership (NEADAP) and the Netherlands Development Organisation (SNV) organised and facilitated the Dairy Dialogue &amp; Business drinks event at Hotel Africana.<br/></p><p>The Dairy dialogue was structured along the four topics of the regional dairy event “Dairy, the motor for healthy growth” (Nairobi, 13 August). These topics are Milk Quality, Forage &amp; Fodder, Inclusiveness and Dairy Professionals. </p><p>The purpose of this event was to reconnect as stakeholders in the Ugandan dairy sector; to share, learn, exchange new dairy developments, technologies and new knowledge. To also build on our collective knowledge to promote, contribute to the necessary changes / transformations for the dairy sector; as well as understanding more about regional dairy event that will be held in Kenya in August under the Netherlands East African Dairy Partnership (NEADAP).</p><p>With welcome remarks from the </p><p></p>...
<a href="//agriprofocus.com/post/5d49771626b72a7e9fcbb948"><b>Read more</b></a>

<p></p><h1>Successful dairy dialogue and business cocktail took place!</h1><p><b>On 19th July 2019, AgriProFocus Rwanda organized a dairy dialogue and business cocktail at chez Lando Hotel. The purpose of this event was to brief Rwandan dairy stakeholders about regional dairy event that will be held in Kenya organized by the Dutch organizations inviting their partners for a regional dairy event. It was also a good opportunity to facilitate the networking among dairy stakeholders in Rwanda.</b></p><p>The event began with the welcome remarks by AgriProFocus Rwanda coordinator, Madam Sajji RYAKUNZE who presented her thanks to the Rwandan dairy stakeholders for their participation in this dairy dialogue and business cocktail. <i>“We can’t make agribusiness work for development in Rwanda without cultivating collaboration with stakeholders like you, the dairy sector is growing well in Rwanda, we see many people investing in and different partners involving in dairy sector. In this dialogue, lets share what has been done,what</i></p><p></p>...

<p></p><h1>Are you eager to know what happened to the 4th Business Drinks of 2019? </h1><p>-	A lot of new faces with different backgrounds had been discussed and shared their thoughts/experiences </p><p>-	Gender balance: half of the participant were women </p><p>We had 6 presenters: I kindly ask you to read them all. </p><p><b>Dr. Samson Eshetu</b> from Farm Radio International shared what farm radio is currently doing and how the local farmers are benefited from this organizations. And he also mentioned that Farm Radio International, Ethiopia is ready to collaborate and work together. Please read more <a href="https://farmradio.org/ethiopia/" target="_blank">here</a></p><p><b>Ms. Lina </b></p><p>Ms. Lina represent GIIC Company, a Gulf Integrated Industry company that is producing plastic materials which are helpful in the agricultural sector, such as electrical and construction materials. “Some of our products include baller twine, agricultural twin and PCC sheet. We believe our company will provide a better agricultural society and more efficient way of farming.”</p><p><b>Mr. Christian </b></p><p>Mr. Christian is from Gebyane</p><p></p>...

<p></p><h1>The Dairy Business Networking Event</h1><p><span>Stakeholders have been invited to have an informal chat about doing business in the Dairy sector in Uganda and also getting to know more about the Netherlands East African Dairy Partnership (NEADAP) in connection with doing business at regional level.</span><br/></p><p>In this 2-hour event starting from 5:00 pm to 7:00 pm at Hotel Africana, stakeholders will have the opportunity to meet new people in their line of business with potential to partner with. The informal chat will also communicate about the African Dairy exhibition and conference scheduled for mid August in Nairobi.</p><p>The Dairy drinks will speak to the Netherlands East Africa Dairy Partnership which aims to promote uptake of interventions and good practices by dairy stakeholders and to generate recommendations for policy makers. Current themes are milk quality, forage, inclusive business models and network approach. NEADAP focus countries are Kenya, Uganda, Ethiopia while partners are SNV, WUR, Agriterra and Bles D</p><p></p>...

<p></p><h1>Promotion de la Culture de Collaboration</h1><h1>AgriProFocus – TRIJEUD - JCI - GYIN </h1><p><span>Dans la dynamique de mise en œuvre du Projet Entrepreneuriat Agricole Jeune, le Réseau AgriProFocus Mali a créé une synergie d’action avec les organisations de jeunesse les plus actives sur la thématique Formation et insertion des jeunes en entrepreneuriat agricole. C’est dans cette logique et pour l’atteinte des objectifs assignés au PEAJ que le réseau a facilité la formation en Entreprenariat Digital au Mali : cas des sites de vente en ligne et L’agrobusiness </span></p><blockquote><div>Contexte<br/> Cette année la TRIJEUD-MALI met un accent particulier sur la promotion de l’entrepreneuriat à l’endroit de la jeunesse malienne en général, et en particulier de ses membres. C’est dans cette optique qu’elle a initié le Rendez-vous « Beirey » qui se veut un évènement mensuel d’échange, d’information et de formation de la jeunesse à l’entrepreneuriat au Mali. </div></blockquote><p>Au total onze (11) Actes, jouxtés de commun</p><p></p>...
